newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex raises Mexico cement prices.
newsitem.headline: Cemex raises Mexico cement prices.

text.p: Cement maker Cemex began to raise sales prices in Mexico last week, a senior company executive said in a conference call with analysts on Monday.
"In fact, Cemex began half-way through last week to cut discounts on the price of cement in central Mexico," said Cemex chief financial officer Rodrigo Trevino.
Cemex had tried to eliminate discounts in January, raising cement prices to $80 per tonne but the market did not absorb the rise and the average price in the quarter fell back to $78, Trevino said.
